name: v15c
description: Systém doprovázení pěstounských rodin — návrh, datový model, testovací data

scripts.dev: cd apps/crm && (test -d node_modules || npm install) && npm run dev
scripts.build: cd apps/crm && (test -d node_modules || npm install) && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:schema && npm run test:rules
scripts.seed:clear: cd tools/seed && npm run seed -- clear
scripts.seed:reseed: cd tools/seed && npm run seed -- reseed
scripts.seed:stats: cd tools/seed && npm run seed -- stats
scripts.seed:dump: cd tools/seed && npm run seed -- dump
